reviewer_statement: Developer-side source-domain review for native R mixed-effects known-truth recovery. Five additional typed frozen Python 1.2 recovery assessments test complete metric/provenance source records with participant, trial, zero variance, multidimensional selected response and Unicode intercept cases. Prior direct source oracle and invalid-domain tests retained. Independent certification and exact-head CI success have not been established.
native_language_semantic_policy: Python typed functional mixed-effects and simulator-truth dataclasses map to explicitly checked native R scientific list records; source fixed-intercept and participant/trial time-domain variance evaluators remain mathematically source-aligned while no Python is invoked from R. Python class and exception identities remain language specific.

case_evidence.description: Frozen eyetrajectoriespy 1.2 recovery.py::evaluate_functional_mixed_effects_recovery typed FunctionalMixedEffectsResult, FunctionSimulationTruth and explicit intercept_name, native R exact-grid fixed-intercept/variance source records.

Five typed source configurations: participant random intercept only, nested trial random intercept, exactly zero participant variance, two-channel/2-mode selected response with alternate coefficient-name position, and Unicode/apostrophe fixed intercept identity.

Five complete direct Python 1.2 source vs native R recovery assessment frames with every registered nine-column scientific metric value, metadata and provenance; prior direct Python one-channel and nested trial source oracle tests retained.

Native R rejects unsupported random slopes, absent fixed intercept, missing trial source variance fit against declared truth, fitted truth-grid mismatch and invalid spline basis covariance geometry; Python runtime dataclass/TypeError class identities are not claimed.

Frozen Python FunctionalRecoveryAssessment ordered metric tuple and fixed provenance map correspond to source-ordered native R recovery assessment/registered value list; nine-column source comparison includes metric labels and nullable component/source fields.

Time-domain fixed-intercept integrated squared error, participant/trial functional variance trajectory squared error, integrated variance absolute and conditional relative error; fitted spline covariance matrices are not compared directly to generating KL eigenvalues or iid scalar residual variance.

independent_review_status: Author-reviewed semantic source assessment only; frozen Python 1.2 exact-head CI, cross-platform qualification and independent scientific certification pending.
language_specific_limits: R scientific fit/assessment object class identity differs from Python dataclasses and immutable tuple results
SciPy/NumPy floating point expression evaluation and BLAS may differ at the final ulp, so comparisons use source-scaled numeric tolerances
The underlying REML estimators, model fitting convergence and full covariance source estimation are separate open contracts; this is only the known-truth evaluation of supplied fits
Source TypeError and ValueError condition classes do not map identically to native R errors
